new_series.title: Michael McIntyre's The Wheel
new_series.synopsis: Michael McIntyre hosts his hit game show. The celebrity experts are Michael Ball, Kate Garraway, Isa Guha, Harriet Kemsley, Matt Morsia, Katherine Ryan, Jordan Banjo and Perri Kiely.

new_series.title: Honey
new_series.synopsis: 1982, East Berlin. MI6’s Martha Schmitt is paired with the CIA’s Kurt Fischer on a disastrous mission. When the Stasi’s Friedrich Baumann makes a demand of her, how can she refuse?

new_series.title: The History Podcast
new_series.synopsis: A boy is sent away to a special school for disabled children, only to discover upon leaving at 16, that he has a lot more to offer the world than he's been told.

new_series.title: The Rector's Wife by Joanna Trollope
new_series.synopsis: Gemma Whelan reads Joanna Trollope’s 1991 best-seller. A quietly subversive story of a woman trapped in an unhappy marriage by convention and loyalty to her husband and his church.

new_series.title: World of Secrets
new_series.synopsis: Prisoners sold their skin for survival in mid-century America. But nobody knew how far the testing programme at Holmesburg Prison would go.

new_series.title: I'm a Celebrity, Get Me Out of Here!
new_series.synopsis: The survival challenge returns with fresh faces setting up camp in the Australian wilderness. Ant and Dec cover the action, while all of the new contestants hope they have what it takes to receive the 2026 crown as King or Queen of the Jungle from last year's victor Angry Ginge.
